shellCommands.command: find /workspace -type f -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -not -path "*/.git/*" -not -path "*/.next/*" | head -60 && echo "---" && cat /workspace/package.json

for f in next.config.ts tsconfig.json app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/ProductSkeleton.tsx app/globals.css lib/products.ts "app/product/[slug]/page.tsx"; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; done

cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs && echo "=== git diff package.json ===" && git diff package.json && echo "=== node_modules? ===" && ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head -5 && echo "=== react version ===" && cat node_modules/react/package.json 2>/dev/null | head -5

ls node_modules/next/dist/compiled | grep -i react | head -20; echo "=== viewTransition mentions in next config/webpack ==="; grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js 2>/dev/null | head -20
grep -rln "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/ 2>/dev/null | head -20
cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md

cd /workspace
echo "=== @types/react version ==="; node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/@types/react/package.json').version)"
echo "=== ViewTransition in @types/react ==="; grep -n "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -20
echo "=== ViewTransition in @types/react/canary or experimental ==="; ls node_modules/@types/react/ | head
echo "=== next Link transitionTypes type ==="; grep -rn "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

cd /workspace
echo "=== canary.d.ts ViewTransition ==="; grep -n "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts | head -30
echo "=== experimental.d.ts ViewTransition ==="; grep -n "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/experimental.d.ts | head -40

cd /workspace; head -40 node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts; echo "=== typesVersions/exports in @types/react pkg ==="; node -e "const p=require('./node_modules/@types/react/package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify({exports:p.exports,types:p.types,typesVersions:p.typesVersions},null,1))"

cd /workspace
echo "=== vendored react version ==="; node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/package.json').version)"
echo "=== ViewTransition export in vendored react ==="; grep -o "exports.ViewTransition[ =]" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.development.js | head -3
echo "=== also production ==="; grep -o "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.production.js | head -3
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -30

(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o 'view-transition-name[^;"]*' | head; echo "--- grid card link/image ---"; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o '<a[^>]*product-card[^>]*>.\{0,180\}' | head -2

cd /workspace; echo "=== detail page ==="; curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o '<div[^>]*product-hero[^>]*>' ; echo "--- back link ---"; curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o '<a[^>]*back-link[^>]*>.\{0,60\}'; echo "--- vt attrs on page wrappers (main / outer div) ---"; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o '<main[^>]*>'; curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o 'vt-[a-z]*="[^"]*"' | sort | uniq -c

cd /workspace; grep -o '"vt-enter"[^;]\{0,200\}' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-server.node.development.js | head -3; echo "=== how classes are serialized (search getViewTransitionClassName / per type) ==="; grep -no 'function [a-zA-Z]*(\(.\{0,20\}\)) *{[^}]*vt-' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-server.node.development.js | head -5

which google-chrome chromium chromium-browser 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; node -e "try{require.resolve('playwright');console.log('playwright available')}catch{console.log('no playwright')}"

cd /workspace; echo "=== transitionTypes present in flight payload (home) ==="; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o 'nav-forward' | wc -l; echo "=== nav-back in detail payload ==="; curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o 'nav-back' | wc -l; echo "=== flight row for a card link ==="; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o 'transitionTypes[^]]\{0,80\}' | head -2

cd /workspace; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o '\\"nav-forward\\":\\"nav-forward\\"' | wc -l; pkill -f "next start" ; echo "=== git status ==="; git status --short; echo "=== tsconfig diff ==="; git diff tsconfig.json; echo "=== gitignore ==="; cat .gitignore
cd /workspace; git status --short; echo "=== tsconfig diff ==="; git diff tsconfig.json; echo "=== gitignore ==="; cat .gitignore

cd /workspace; (npx next dev -p 3122 > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &); sleep 12; echo "=== home ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:3122/; curl -s localhost:3122/product/cotton-hoodie | grep -o 'vt-[a-z]*="[^"]*"' | sort | uniq -c; echo "=== dev log errors ==="; grep -iE "error|warn|invalid" /tmp/dev.log | head -10; pkill -f "next dev"; sleep 1; echo done
cd /workspace; git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo next-env.d.ts && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -10; echo "tsc exit: $?"; git status --short
cd /workspace; rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; ls -la AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md; echo "=== CLAUDE.md ==="; cat CLAUDE.md; echo "=== AGENTS.md ==="; cat AGENTS.md
cd /workspace; git --no-pager diff -- app/ ; echo "=== NEW: app/view-transitions.ts + react-canary.d.ts (already shown above) ==="; git status --short
